units.source_text: 假如这个实验成功的话，那就再也不会因断水而投降了。

en.t: If this experiment succeeded, they would never have to surrender because of a water cutoff again.

units.source_text: 岂止如此，这沙子整个就是一个水泵。

en.t: More than that, the sand itself was one great water pump.

units.source_text: 自己简直就像坐在抽水泵上似的。

en.t: He felt as though he were sitting right on top of a pump.

units.source_text: 男人为了平息过快的心跳，甚至需要屏气凝神，静静蹲下。

en.t: To calm his racing heartbeat, the man even had to hold his breath, steady himself, and crouch down quietly.

units.source_text: 当然，他还没有同别人说的必要。

en.t: Of course, he still had no need to tell anyone else.

units.source_text: 万一有情况，它还是十分要紧的武器呢。

en.t: If something happened, it would still be an extremely important weapon.
